facts.note: Rosa says the American kitchen clock is a quarter of an hour fast and that she keeps it so on purpose, so nothing is ever late.
Lina came down at thirteen minutes to eleven by the kitchen clock and stayed with Rosa until after the temple struck eleven.
The piano began at two minutes to eleven and stopped at eleven minutes past eleven, both by the kitchen clock.
The hall clock struck eleven when the kitchen clock showed thirteen minutes past eleven.

added.quote:
You stayed in the kitchen for the whole evening?

ROSA: Where else would I be, Monsieur? Madame does not want the maid in the dining room with the gentlemen.
added.why: Rosa claims she was in the kitchen for the whole evening, so she is placed there at every moment before eleven and is not a witness to the dining room or the stairs during that span.
